pr_title: Use clean URL for sharing and opening in browser
pr_comment: Have you checked this for every call of `ShareUtils.shareUrl()` and `ShareUtils.openUrlInBrowser()`?

I actually don't know where to find these "dirty" URLs to test. 😅 I just went by what Mauricio said here https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/issues/3247#issuecomment-602880441.

Apart from that I've tested all calls, and they all work. Testing both Share and Open in Browser is redundant, though. It's the same URL. If it doesn't work for one, it wouldn't work for the other case either.
Yes! But invert the `?:`: `cleanUrl == null ? url : cleanUrl`

review_comment:
You could just use `currentInfo.getUrl()` here as well, as `currentInfo` is defined in the `BaseListInfoFragment` that it extends.

Also please squash your commits.
So I should replace `cleanUrl == null ? url : cleanUrl` with `currentInfo.getUrl()`? I can basically revert the last commit and make this change instead, right?
